purpose: Test a new beam-aware material mechanism on the verified 1.025259456 r96 package. I-23 is used only to identify O1 description-to-SID rows whose full gold triple is present in the teacher beam64 and absent from the r96 beam64. This is a construction filter, not an online-score estimator.

construction_teacher.allowed_role: Frozen beam construction scorer only; never a policy initializer and never a non-gold positive-label source.

result_before_training_protocol.exclusions: Every registered prompt-bearing E/holdout by exact and /think-/no_think-normalized prompt hash, plus formal I-30 and I-33 training prompts.
result_before_training_protocol.deduplication: One deterministic row per full gold domain+s_a+s_b+s_c; conflicting prompts are rejected.
result_before_training_protocol.split_group: domain+s_a+s_b; groups cannot cross train-pool and gate-pool.
result_before_training_protocol.beam_renderer: Platform mirror: qwen3 no-think assistant prefix, append the gold domain token, unconstrained beam search width 64, max_tokens 3, BF16, seed 42.
result_before_training_protocol.valid_candidate: Exactly s_a+s_b+s_c in that order; partial, invalid, early-stop, wrong-domain, or extra-token sequences are not candidates.
result_before_training_protocol.hard_gap: The full gold triple occurs in I-23 beam64 and does not occur in r96 beam64.
result_before_training_protocol.formal_material_selection: Select 128 train hard-gap rows deterministically. First allocate 16 per domain by SHA256, then allocate the remaining 64 by global SHA256 round-robin over available domains. Do not rank or tune by beam score.
result_before_training_protocol.negative_selection: Only complete wrong r96 beam triples are negatives. Exclude the gold and every known positive for the same normalized prompt; keep at most four unique candidates per first-divergence level in parent beam order. I-23 non-gold beams are never positives.

known_positive_contract_check.meaning: For these frozen pools, excluding the row gold is exactly equivalent to excluding every known positive for the normalized prompt.

precompute_result.interpretation: The I-23 online material tier does not produce a transferable beam64 advantage on this frozen native-no-think desc2sid distribution: teacher minus parent full-gold hits is only +1/1024 on train and 0/256 on gate. The preregistered construction mechanism therefore has insufficient support.
forbidden_followups_in_v1: post-result threshold, rank, learning-rate, margin, or scale sweep

frozen_training_recipe_after_admission.parent_initialization: Merge the verified r96 into O6, freeze it, then create one fresh residual.
frozen_training_recipe_after_admission.material_loss: Mean over available first-divergence levels of mean softplus(0.1-(gold_logit-negative_logit)) + 0.1 gold CE on a,b,c,EOS + 0.02 frozen-r96 forward KL on a,b,c,EOS.
frozen_training_recipe_after_admission.retention_loss: 4.0 frozen-r96 forward KL only, capped at 96 uniformly spaced answer-body positions.
frozen_training_recipe_after_admission.checkpoint_contents: Fresh r16 adapter only; no optimizer/scheduler/RNG and no frozen parent.

checkpoint_gate.selection_rule: Choose the earliest checkpoint that passes every hard gate. Residual scale is fixed at 1.0; no LR, margin, scale, rank, or checkpoint interpolation sweep is allowed in I-34 v1.

packaging_after_all_gates.operation: Exact LoRA concatenation r96+r16 at scale 1.0.
required_audits: fixed-prompt parent+residual versus concatenated logits identity
strict two-file package, rank, dtype, and byte count

online_success_definition: Only a locally accepted strict r112 package may use one manual platform evaluation. Success requires material >=0.275958188 and total >1.025259456 under the same fixed protocol. One result is an observed point, not a stability claim.
